title: zornia canescens
intro: Zornia canescens, commonly known as hairy zornia or gray zornia, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae, native to the Americas. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its use as a natural remedy for fever reduction, and as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Zornia canescens include its ability to act as a diuretic, to relieve coughs and respiratory issues, and to exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Zornia canescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
